author: Amanda G. Hotard
text: Knowledgeable, friendly, and prompt. Highly recommend TL septic for sewage services. #1 in the #2 business!!

author: vicki cannon
text: I highly recommend TL Septic. In 2016  Terry showed up the day after I called him and got the job done. Fast forward 10 years and Jeremy offers the same great service just as quick as Terry. Thanks TL Septic for all that you do!

author: Toni Ponson
text: Making contact with Mr. TL was easy. I was able to get an appointment within a couple of days of our initial conversation. Mr. TL was early to the site and did not tarry. He got straight to the job. He explained the septic process and advised of ongoing preventative maintenance. He had a great attitude, very cordial, and very professional. I would totally recommend Mr. TL Septic without any hesitation!

author: Robert Marionneaux
text: Jeremy came out within 2 hours of me calling him. Very helpful and got the job done.

author: Alan Chatman
text: We have only had positive experiences with TL Septic over the last 16+ years.  TL is quick to respond and provide pump-out service at their first opportunity.  The crew always does a thorough job and communicates if any issues are encountered that we were not aware of.  Highly recommend TL Septic to anyone.
